sources.name: 위키백과·Wikipedia
rules: Use MediaWiki API instead of screen scraping
Store language, canonical URL, page ID, revision ID and accessedAt
Do not copy or closely translate prose by default
When adapting text, provide attribution and comply with share-alike terms

sources.name: Grokipedia
sources.license: xAI Community License; some pages may also be CC BY-SA 4.0
rules: Do not bulk ingest article prose
Use only to discover omissions or disagreements
Verify every candidate claim with independent primary sources
Record page-specific license when available

sources.name: arXiv
rules: Use public API for metadata
Cite the original paper and version
Do not assume all full text has the same reuse license
Include the arXiv data-use acknowledgement when API data is published

sources.name: ACL Anthology
sources.license: 2016+ ACL materials CC BY 4.0; earlier ACL materials CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; third-party materials vary
rules: Store Anthology ID and DOI
Check publication year and material ownership
Cite the canonical paper page

sources.name: 표준·공식 명세·공식 문서
rules: Prefer versioned permalinks
Record publisher, version and accessedAt
Use product documentation only for that product's behavior
Do not treat marketing claims as independent evidence

sources.name: Semantic Scholar·OpenReview 등 학술 색인
rules: Use to discover papers and citation relations
Cite the original paper rather than the index record
Do not count an index as an independent evidence source
